title: Compose local photo upload in the PWA

gates.name: photo_upload_browser
gates.command: cd frontend && npm run test:e2e -- tests/e2e/photo-upload.spec.ts

verify: Independent browser/API verification covers one real multipart upload, exact safe checksum/manifest/event refs, invalid/large/denied/archive failures, and no partially accepted artifact.
evidence_required: FT-016-AC-019 RED: no browser multipart upload consumer exists; GREEN: an authorized real test file returns and renders the exact safe checksum/manifest/event refs while unsupported, oversized, denied, and archived cases remain non-accepted; decisive comparison: multipart request, backend response, DOM, and post-failure artifact state; artifact: upload evidence under .tasks/TASK-084-T3-FT-016-W3/.
purpose: Expose the accepted local-photo upload result to the Engineer without acquiring file, manifest, Dataset, upload-server, or sync authority.
success_outcome: The selected-Plant PWA submits a real local test photo only through Photo Intake HTTP and shows the returned safe refs with truthful non-acceptance failures and no remote-upload implication.
anti_goals: Do not implement photo catalog pagination, read/write local artifact paths directly, generate manifests, recompute hashes, or imply server/cloud upload.
Do not make PhotoCatalogSummary.can_train_on mutable or authoritative for Dataset Governance.

forbidden_scope: remote upload, server sync, thumbnails, annotations, or export packaging
stop_conditions: The browser needs a local filesystem path or a route outside Photo Intake HTTP.
The UI would imply upload/server availability or mutate Dataset trainability.

constraints: Primary owner is Operator PWA; Photo Intake retains file, catalog, checksum, manifest, event, and acceptance authority.
Browser validation is advisory; backend response and safe errors are decisive.
invariants: Photo acceptance remains local_only and never implies remote sync.
Paths, auth material, unsafe filenames, and raw errors never enter the PWA or capture input.
verification_targets: FT-016-AC-019: real local upload, exact safe refs, invalid/large/denied/archive behavior, and no partial artifact or server/path leakage.
T3 harm proof isolates photo roots and database state, verifies failed uploads leave no accepted artifact, and cleans temporary files safely.
